scope: Possible value connections through plain Python strings. Not runtime exception safety or shared-object support.
model: Explicit CPython builtins model; ordinary scalar values and plain str, without replacement builtins or overloaded object protocols.
receiver: A receiver is the value before a method name: label in label.lower(). Establish plain str from literals, checked conversions, local assignments and normal helper returns.
arguments: Positional arguments only. Text arguments require plain str; stripping also accepts None. A replacement count requires a literal integer.
evaluation: Evaluate the receiver once, then arguments from left to right. Return a string without changing the receiver.
propagation: Keep possible origins from the receiver and every argument. Changing case does not sanitize customer input.
merges: Keep a string fact at a branch or loop join only when every arriving path establishes it. Reassignment replaces the prior fact.
summaries: A helper return supports string methods only after every modeled normal return establishes plain str. Annotation text alone supplies no such fact.
refusals: Unknown objects, replaced str, unknown method signatures, expanded arguments and exhausted receiver checks stay incomplete.
generalization: Repeat examples after renaming functions and moving files. Check ordinary Python outcomes before examining the reserved package.
